Players must reach the finish within the time limit - faster times and fewer collisions yield higher scores. Control your skier by swiping left/right (faster swipes increase speed), while avoiding obstacles that deduct points. Real-time displays show distance, speed, and time remaining, with final results including completion time, collisions, and calories burned.



>> Features of Interactive Skiing:


  • Swipe-to-Control Interface: Left/right swipes simulate skier movement with variable speed control.

  • Obstacle Avoidance Mechanics: Points are deducted for each collision, adding a layer of challenge.

  • Real-Time Data Display: Tracks distance, speed, time left, and calories burned during the game.

  • Performance-Based Scoring: Final scores are calculated based on time, collisions, and efficiency.

  • HD Visuals & Immersive Audio: Brings a virtual winter sports environment to life.

  • Interactive Feedback: Encourages replayability and skill improvement with instant result summaries.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Interactive Skiing:





Physical Engagement: Promotes cardiovascular activity and coordination through full-body motion.


Skill Training: Sharpens reaction time and decision-making under pressure.


Entertainment Venues: Ideal for arcades, fitness centers, sports complexes, and event attractions.




Gamified Fitness: Blends gameplay with exercise for both fun and wellness.


Data-Driven Performance Tracking: Useful for progress monitoring and personal goal setting.


Broad Audience Appeal: Easy to learn, yet challenging to master—suitable for all age groups.



>> Product Number: LJST010


  • Floor area: 2.9m*2m*2.6m

  • Number of people: 1 person

  • Participation time: 3-5 minutes

  • Power: 270w



>> FAQs for Interactive Skiing:


Q1: How is the skier controlled during gameplay?

A1: Players swipe left or right on the interface to steer. Faster swipes increase the skier’s speed.


Q2: What happens when players hit obstacles?

A2: Each collision deducts points from the final score and may slow down progress.


Q3: Is this product suitable for fitness training?

A3: Yes, it promotes movement, burns calories, and helps improve agility and reflexes.


Q4: Can the system track player progress over time?

A4: Yes, it records key metrics like completion time, number of collisions, and calories burned.


Q5: What type of venues can install Interactive Skiing?

A5: It is suitable for amusement parks, sports centers, gyms, training studios, and school recreational areas.
